English: Baptismal Basin
A humble wooden basin, set near the entrance of a makeshift chapel, filled with blessed water for simple baptisms and rituals.
Wooden Baptistery
A free-standing timber structure near the church, providing a dedicated space for baptisms and minor instruction in the faith.
Stone Baptistery
A sturdy stone baptistery, symbolizing the growing permanence of the faith, and offering improved instruction and security for ceremonies.
Decorated Baptistery
A stone baptistery adorned with carvings and iconography, inspiring awe and reverence among the faithful.
Baptistery Pool
A grand immersion pool constructed for elaborate baptismal rites, attended by clergy and watched by the faithful.
Ornate Baptistery
Lavishly adorned with mosaics and sacred relics, the ornate baptistery draws pilgrims and scholars alike.
Cloistered Baptistery
Enclosed by a serene cloister, this baptistery becomes a center for religious learning and isolated prayer.
Grand Baptistery
A vast and majestic baptistery, with high domes and intricate artwork, serving as the spiritual heart of the region.
Sanctified Baptistery
Consecrated by high clergy, this baptistery radiates sanctity, drawing pilgrims and reinforcing the faith of the entire community.
Cathedral Baptistery
The ultimate expression of faith: a monumental baptistery attached to the cathedral, resplendent with relics, holy art, and a beacon of spiritual power.
